name: Wizard Mage
body:
A mage is a wizard who follows the way of the witch. She could have had different masters, or she just could desire to have a more complete comprehension of magic. The mage becomes capable of working some witch hexes, without losing her wizard status.

Hexes: A mage gains a witch hex at 1st level and may select a new hex every time she could gain a wizard’s bonus feat (at 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th level). At 10th level the mage can select a hex or major hex. At 20th level the mage can select a hex, major hex or grand hex. The mage can still select an arcane discovery in place of a feat or a hex. This replaces Scribe Scroll and the normal wizard’s bonus feat progression.
